name: Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) for Tomography
definition: SNR measures the robustness of a reconstruction method to acquisition noise. It compares a reconstruction from a clean sinogram ($J$) with one from a noisy sinogram ($J_B$).
summary: Signal-to-Noise Ratio for Tomography evaluates reconstruction robustness by comparing outputs from clean and noisy sinograms, isolating algorithm sensitivity to input perturbations rather than fidelity to ground truth.
